Method.description: Declare an instance method in a class or a mixin method in a module; use module fun for a method on the Module object.

Class.description: Declare a class with an executable declaration body.

Module.description: Declare a module with an executable declaration body.

Contract.description: Declare a contract with a bodyless method requirement, not an executable method body.

Conditional.description: Evaluate a block when the condition is truthy.

While loop.description: Repeat while the condition is truthy; the default condition avoids an infinite loop.

For loop.description: Iterate a collection with a fresh immutable binding for each element.
